theorem tendsto_actualSelectedPrefixUpperOwnCubeSum
    (I : Finset (Fin 5)) (old nu a b : ℚ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hold : 0 < old)
    (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin 5 → Fin (m + 1))) (cap : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hcap : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {N : ℕ | 0 < N ∧ Even N},
      (N : ℝ) ^ (b : ℝ) ≤ (cap N : ℝ)) :

      actualSelectedPrefixOwnCubeSum false N (cap N) ((N : ℝ) ^ (b : ℝ))
        I old nu a b m J * Real.log (N : ℝ) / singularSeries N)
      (atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {N : ℕ | 0 < N ∧ Even N})

    (I : Finset (Fin 5)) (old nu a b : ℚ)

theorem fifthCappedUpperPolicy_frontier_four
    (base : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (Q3 Q5 : List ℕ → ℝ)
    (h : ℕ → ℝ) (pre carrier : List ℕ) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ) :
    firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (fifthCappedUpperPolicy base Q3 Q5)
        h pre positive mass carrier =
      firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
        h pre positive mass carrier

theorem actualHistoricalFourthSaving_eq
    (base : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (Q3 Q4 : List ℕ → ℝ) (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ)
    (hlevel : ∀ state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      Q3 (rosserAncestor 3 state.selectedPrefix) ≤ Q4 state.selectedPrefix) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (fourthCappedUpperPolicy base Q3 Q4)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) =
      actualHistoricalFourthSaving base Q3 Q4 N cap z

theorem actualHistoricalFifthSaving_eq
    (base : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (Q3 Q4 Q5 : List ℕ → ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ)
    (h34 : ∀ state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      Q3 (rosserAncestor 3 state.selectedPrefix) ≤ Q4 state.selectedPrefix)
    (h45 : ∀ frontier ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      ∀ candidate ∈ firstExitNextSelectionCandidates
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) frontier.selectedPrefix
        frontier.positive frontier.mass frontier.remaining,
        Q4 frontier.selectedPrefix ≤ Q5 candidate.selectedPrefix) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (fourthCappedUpperPolicy base Q3 Q4)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (fifthCappedUpperPolicy base Q3 Q5)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) =
      actualHistoricalFifthSaving base Q3 Q4 Q5 N cap z

theorem actualHistoricalThirdToFifthSaving_eq
    (base : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (Q3 Q4 Q5 : List ℕ → ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (z : ℝ)
    (h34 : ∀ state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      Q3 (rosserAncestor 3 state.selectedPrefix) ≤ Q4 state.selectedPrefix)
    (h45 : ∀ frontier ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier 4 (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z),
      ∀ candidate ∈ firstExitNextSelectionCandidates
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) frontier.selectedPrefix
        frontier.positive frontier.mass frontier.remaining,
        Q4 frontier.selectedPrefix ≤ Q5 candidate.selectedPrefix) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base Q3)
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (fifthCappedUpperPolicy base Q3 Q5)

related_pr3.body:
The actual finite fifth-prefix selector now has a proved integral limit for its complete saving from an ordinary upper parent. Exact half-open ownership makes the outside contribution cancel, while the original parent tests and both own-cube gates remain. The proof handles discrete prime mass on cell boundaries and also derives the selected tree's normalized density in the ordinary sieve's legal range.

The historical third, fourth and fifth policies now share a proved common frontier. Actual third admission and sorted-prime recursion supply inherited validity, and the two finite density changes telescope on that same tree. The manuscript's joint historical cell construction, certificate identification, signed progression distribution, and final counting bounds remain open. Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.2 are not complete.

Validation uses pinned Lean 4.33.0-rc1 and unchanged dependency revisions. All six new modules pass strict individual compilation and independent review. The full aggregate build passes 9,776 jobs; all six final objects pass kernel replay; all 87 owned declarations, including private/generated ones, pass the canonical safety and transitive-axiom audit with only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.

At commit `1a80c1bcce67886f699d097fc37fd245cd3620bf`, GitHub Actions jobs did not start because of the account payment/spending-limit condition reported by GitHub. The validation above is local. Detailed scope and reproduction commands are in `docs/PROOF_STATUS.md`.
